message: I agree with you, Mike--it doesn't seem odd or difficult at all that some the owning class get surplus (profit) of their own making. It seems at least somewhat relevant that our notions of class have changed markedly since Marx wrote: middle class now means "Have to work every day for a living" and only other people are working class. One of the things that interests me is how my students (or yours) would self-identify regarding class, and whether or how that impacts their attitudes toward the ends of their education. I've not thought it out completely, but I'm interested in what you discover.
